report.root_cause: server.properties was changed at ~07:24:55 to white-list=true and enforce-whitelist=true while whitelist.json was empty, so all players (Steve_Mines, Alex_Builds, and others) were rejected with "You are not whitelisted on this server!".
report.actions: Checked status and logs and saw repeated whitelist rejections. Read server.properties and whitelist.json (empty). Declared the incident. Ran the console command "whitelist off". Edited server.properties to set white-list=false and enforce-whitelist=false. Verified with status that Steve_Mines and Alex_Builds were back online and TPS was 20. I did not restart the server.
report.residual_risk: I don't know who or what changed the whitelist settings, so they could be re-enabled. Whitelist is now off and the server runs in offline mode (online-mode=false), so anyone can join. If a whitelist is wanted, populate whitelist.json first. Several unknown players (newplayer12 to newplayer17) tried to join; I did not check whether they should have access.
